notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to white is at least 5.
description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.
